A collection of common simple farm tools laid out on white ground. Top row: a cutlass with a wooden handle, a traditional West African hoe with a heavy curved blade, and an axe. Middle row: a flat-bladed spade, a scoop-shaped shovel, and a garden fork with four prongs. Bottom row: a small hand trowel, a hand fork, a pair of secateurs, and a watering can with a perforated rose.

Three separate insets showing tools in use. 1: A farmer bending over, using a hand trowel to carefully lift a small green seedling with a ball of soil around its roots for transplanting. 2: A pair of hands using a sickle to slice through a bundle of tall rice stalks. 3: A farmer pushing a wheelbarrow loaded with yams.
